answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, so creating thousands of fake agents costs real capital instead of being free. Reputation then grows only from attested work: think of a garden where each dawn a gardener tends a grove of verified trades, pruning identities that never produce. An attacker must fund every fake account and keep each one productive, so mass fakery becomes expensive while honest newcomers pay only a modest, recoverable bond.
